title: Adic quotients of a finite-type localization are unchanged after completing the local base
statement: Let (R, m) be a Noetherian local ring, let R^ be its m-adic completion, let C be a finite-type R-algebra, and let q be a prime of C containing mC. Put D=C tensor_R R^. If Q is a prime of D whose contraction to C is q and whose contraction to R^ is the maximal ideal, then for every n\geq1 the canonical local map C_q \to D_Q induces an isomorphism C_q/(q C_q)^n \to D_Q/(Q D_Q)^n. The isomorphisms are compatible with the quotient transition maps. The notions of Noetherian ring, completion, finite-type morphism, localization at a prime, and tensor product are those of [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and [def-weil-module-base-change].
